Container.Name: diaper-counter
Container.Overview: Diaper Counter is a Blazor Server app for tracking xixi, coco, or both diapers. This image is produced by GitHub Actions and should run with a MongoDB Community App on the private diaper-counter Docker network.
Container.Description: Before installing from a private GitHub repository, log in to ghcr.io from the Unraid terminal with a GitHub token that has read:packages. Install MongoDB from Unraid Community Apps first, put it on the diaper-counter Docker network, then set this template's Mongo connection string to match it. For the public tunnel, install Unraid-Cloudflared-Tunnel from Community Apps and change its network from bridge to diaper-counter.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the Diaper Counter web app and Unraid WebUI link. When using Unraid-Cloudflared-Tunnel on the same Docker network, route Cloudflare to http://diaper-counter:8080 instead.

Config.Name: ASPNETCORE_URLS
Config.Description: ASP.NET Core listen URL inside the container.

Config.Name: MongoDB Connection String
Config.Description: MongoDB connection string. Use the same username and password configured in the MongoDB Community App. Keep the MongoDB container name as diaper-counter-mongodb or update this host value.

Config.Name: MongoDB Database Name
Config.Description: Database name used by Diaper Counter.

Config.Name: Time Zone
Config.Description: Time zone used for daily diaper counts.
